description.value: Horstman Hut is an on-mountain dining venue operated by Whistler Blackcomb, located high on Blackcomb Mountain near the Horstman Glacier area. It functions as a warming hut and restaurant serving guests accessing the alpine zone, primarily in winter by chairlift and in summer via the PEAK 2 PEAK gondola or on-mountain hiking. For a touring cyclist, reaching it on two wheels would require either lift access or a substantial mountain climb.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website was fetched successfully but the page content for the Horstman Hut dining page loaded only navigation and header elements — no descriptive text, menu, or amenity details for the hut itself were captured. OSM tags confirm name and restaurant category. Coordinates (50.0918683, -122.8843877) place this on Blackcomb Mountain at elevation, not in the village as the URL path implies, suggesting it is an on-mountain alpine dining facility accessible primarily via ski lifts or significant mountain hiking rather than directly by road cyclist.

OSM coordinates place this restaurant high on Blackcomb Mountain (alpine zone), not in the village as suggested by the URL path '/the-village/dining/'. Access for cyclists likely requires paid gondola/chairlift tickets or significant off-road mountain hiking.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, publicly accessible restaurant operated by Whistler Blackcomb; the website confirms its existence and the business is not listed as closed. Access requires lift tickets or alpine hiking, which is worth noting for cyclists but is not grounds for exclusion.
enrichment_extras.notes: The Horstman Hut is a seasonal alpine venue. Cyclists considering visiting should verify seasonal lift access (summer alpine experience tickets) via the Whistler Blackcomb website before making the trip.
